sn11.5:1.1: Sāvatthi nidānaṃ || || Bhūtapubbam bhikkhave devāsurasaṅgāmo samupabbūḷho ahosi || || Atha kho bhikkhave Vepacitti asurindo Sakkaṃ devānam indam etad avoca || || Hotu devānam inda subhāsitena jayo ti || || Hotu Vepacitti subhāsitena jayo ti || || Atha kho bhikkhave devā ca asurā ca pārisajje ṭhapesuṃ || ime no subhāsitaṃ dubbhāsitam ājānissantī ti || || Atha kho bhikkhave Vepacitti asurindo Sakkaṃ devānam indam etad avoca || || Bhaṇa devānam inda gāthan ti || || Evaṃ vutte bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo Vepacittim asurindam etad avoca || || Tumhe khv-attha Vepacitti pubbadevā || bhaṇa Vepacitti gāthan ti || || Evaṃ vutte bhikkhave Vepacitti asurindo imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn11.5:2.1: Bhiyyo bālā pakujjheyyuṃ || no c-assa paṭisedhako || tasmā bhusena daṇḍena || dhīro bālam nisedhaye ti || ||
sn11.5:3.1: Bhāsitāya kho pana bhikkhave Vepacittinā asurindena gāthāya asurā anumodiṃsu || devā tuṇhī ahesuṃ || || Atha kho bhikkhave Vepacitti asurindo Sakkaṃ devānam indam etad avoca || || Bhaṇa devānam inda gāthan ti || || Evam vutte bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn11.5:4.1: Etad eva ahaṃ maññe || bālassa paṭisedhanaṃ || paraṃ saṅkupitaṃ ñatvā || yo sato upasammatī ti || ||
sn11.5:5.1: Bhāsitāya kho pana bhikkhave Sakkena devānam indena gāthāya devā anumodiṃsu || asurā tuṇhī ahesuṃ || || Atha kho bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo Vepacittim asurindam etad avoca || || Bhaṇa Vepacitti gāthan ti || || Etad eva titikkhāya || vajjaṃ
sn11.5:6.1: passāmi Vāsava || yadā naṃ maññati bālo || bhayā myāyaṃ titikkhati || ajjhārūhati dummedho || go va bhiyyo palāyinan ti || ||
sn11.5:7.1: Bhāsitāya kho pana bhikkhave Vepacittinā asurindena gāthāya asurā anumodiṃsu || devā tuṇhī ahesuṃ || || Atha kho bhikkhave Vepacitti asurindo Sakkaṃ devā. nam indam etad avoca || || Bhaṇa devānam inda gāthan ti || || Evaṃ vutte bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo imā gāthāyo abhāsi || ||
sn11.5:8.1: Kāmaṃ maññatu vā mā vā || bhayā myāyam titikkhati || sadatthaparamā atthā || khantyā bhiyyo na vijjati || ||
sn11.5:9.1: yo have balavā santo || dubbalassa titikkhati || tam āhu paramaṃ khantiṃ || niccaṃ khamati dubbalo ||
sn11.5:10.1: Abalan-tam balaṃ āhu || yassa bālabalaṃ balaṃ || balassa dhammaguttassa || paṭivattā na vijjati || ||
sn11.5:11.1: Tass-eva tena pāpiyo || yo kuddhaṃ paṭikujjhati || kuddham appaṭikujjhanto || saṅgāmaṃ jeti dujjayaṃ || ||
sn11.5:12.1: ubhinnam atthaṃ carati || attano ca parassa ca || paraṃ saṅkupitaṃ ñatvā || yo sato upasammati || ||
sn11.5:13.1: ubhinnam tikicchantaṃ taṃ || attano ca parassa ca || janā maññanti bālo ti || ye dhammassa akovidā ti || ||
sn11.5:14.1: Bhāsitāsu kho pana bhikkhave Sakkena devānam indena gāthāsu devā anumodiṃsu || asurā tuṇhī ahesuṃ || || Atha kho bhikkhave devānañ ca asurānañ ca parisajjā etad avocuṃ || || Bhāsitā kho Vepacittinā asurindena gāthayo || tā ca kho sadaṇḍāvacarā satthāvacarā iti bhaṇḍanam iti viggaho iti kalaho ti || || Bhāsitā kho Sakkena devānam indena gāthāyo || tā ca kho adaṇḍāvacarā asatthāvacarā iti abhaṇḍanam iti aviggaho iti akalaho || Sakkassa devānam indassa subhāsitena jayo ti || || Iti kho bhikkhave Sakkassa devānam indassa subhāsitena jayo ahosi || ||
